method: cuobjdump --dump-ptx + --dump-sass (sm_80, CUDA 12.8); PTX shows ex2.approx.ftz.f32, SASS counts MUFU opcodes over the full function body.

compiled_path.expf: ex2.approx.ftz.f32 (MUFU.EX2) + correction polynomial (FADD/FFMA/FMUL) for full precision
compiled_path.__expf: ex2.approx.ftz.f32 (MUFU.EX2) only; reduced-range fast intrinsic (~2 ULP rel error)
compiled_path.exp2f(x*log2e): compiles to the SAME bare-EX2 SASS as __expf (NOT the correction-polynomial path) => NOT bit-exact to expf

key_findings.mufu_ex2_invariant: MUFU.EX2 count identical (9) across expf/__expf/exp2f => the expf->SFU mapping is fixed; no formulation reduces the SFU instruction count.
key_findings.float_op_difference: expf has ~12 more float ops (FADD 38 vs 34, FFMA 121 vs 105) = the correction polynomial; __expf/exp2f drop it (faster but approximate).
key_findings.exp2f_not_exact: exp2f(x*log2e) produces the same bare-EX2 SASS as __expf => it is APPROXIMATE, not bit-exact to expf. Cannot be classified EXACT_PATH.

registers_spill: all three variants: 67 registers, 0 spill (clean build, no --use_fast_math)
tooling_note: ncu 2021.3.1 incompatible (error 6); nvprof 11.5 too old. Static SASS/PTX used (decisive for instruction-mix audit).
